remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 3 full bath condo in the highly desirable Chesterfield complex. This stunning unit features all-new wood flooring on the main level, new baseboards and trim, recessed lighting, updated outlets and switches, a new electrical panel, fresh paint, updated thermostats, new blinds, and modern vent covers. The living room showcases a custom stone accent wall with fireplace, custom mantle, custom built-in bar with cabinets and bar lighting, and a stylish entryway. The dining room offers hardwood floors and a dimmer switch which leads to sliders to the outdoor balcony. The kitchen is fully remodeled with all new appliances, quartz marble countertops, custom cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, and a custom pantry. Main level bedrooms include custom closets and ceiling fans, with a fully renovated primary master bath. The beautifully finished lower level offers an amazing flexible space ideal for a family room/game room with more options, optional 3rd bedroom, office, or guest room. The fully finished basement also features a full bathroom, new railing, new stairs and flooring as well as a laundry room with built shelves. Indulge in the complex's heated in-ground pool which is only 3 doors down from the pool. This inviting community is just minutes from the train, shopping, dining, and more!
